subject: Re: MV2 surge — provisional capacity top-up & invoice reconciliation
messages:
From: Oliver Stevens <oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pinetree.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: MV2 spike — need short-term capacity and invoice note

Jasmine,

Quick note — we observed a sustained MV2 inference spike during the last seven days (attached usage_report_May2027.csv). Our product team pushed a model change on May 26 and traffic doubled; rate limits throttled traffic starting Monday which impacted checkout latency.

Can Redwood provision a short-term capacity uplift for the next 72 hours while we stabilize? We also need an accounting path for the overage — can that be reconciled on the next invoice or do we need a PO now?

Key asks: 
- Temporary quota uplift (~2x baseline) for 72 hours starting now
- Confirm blended rate for the uplift and whether Redwood can issue a one-time credit for the interruption
- If PO is required, can you confirm the exact description and amount so procurement can generate it (we can email PO to procurement@pinetree.ai)

Appreciate a quick turnaround — this is live-ticking for our engineering team.

— Oliver
Oliver Stevens
CTO, PineTree Retail
oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai

Attachment: usage_report_May2027.csv (CSV, 1.4MB)

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Stevens <oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MV2 spike — need short-term capacity and invoice note

Oliver — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the report. I’m sorry this disrupted checkout. We’ll do two things immediately:

1) Provision a provisional capacity uplift for up to 72 hours while your team stabilizes the MV2 roll.
2) Align billing mechanics and provide a suggested PO description for procurement.

Prelim details from our side:
- Provisional uplift: we can enable a temporary 2x quota increase at the existing tier for up to 72 hours.
- Surge window: we’ll start the uplift as soon as you confirm "GO".
- Billing: we can either invoice the uplift at a one-time blended rate or apply it as a provisional charge and reconcile on next invoice; Ben (cc) will advise the cleanest audit trail.

Karthik — can you confirm the blended uplift rate we can offer and whether we can apply a one-time operational credit for the service disruption? Ben — if PineTree sends a PO, what fields do you need to tie it to DEAL-PT-00459?

Oliver, if you can share an approximate peak QPS (or a conservative ceiling) we’ll size the uplift and produce a proforma. I’ve attached provisional_topup_terms.pdf with the short T&C we typically use.

Next steps:
- Oliver: confirm GO or PO number
- Redwood: enable uplift and send proforma invoice if PO is requested

Thanks — I’ll keep this on my radar until closed.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Attachment: provisional_topup_terms.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Stevens <oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MV2 surge — provisional capacity top-up & invoice reconciliation

Oliver — Karthik here. Appreciate you flagging this and for the quick artifact. We can do a clean short-window uplift and propose an automated reconciliation path to minimize procurement friction.

Proposal (72-hour window):
- Temporary uplift at a blended rate of $0.0018 per request (blended to avoid per-token nuance for the short window).
- If PineTree agrees to the uplift within 6 hours, Redwood will:
  - Enable provisional capacity up to 2x baseline immediately.
  - Offer a one-time service credit of $12,000 to offset the disruption if PineTree signs the attached short-form amendment (provisional_topup_terms.pdf).
- Cap: we’ll hold uplift to the smaller of 2x baseline or an absolute ceiling you nominate.

If that sounds acceptable I’ll have Ben generate a proforma surge invoice that PineTree can reference in the PO. This keeps things auditable for your finance team and makes the next invoice carry the reconciliation entry (credit applied).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want to run numbers.

— Karthik Iyer
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Stevens <oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MV2 surge — proforma and PO guidance

Oliver — quick billing note so procurement has everything they need.

We can support two approaches:

A) PO now referencing a proforma surge invoice (we will send surge_invoice_proforma.pdf) — Redwood applies charges against that proforma; reconciliation happens on your next monthly invoice with any agreed credits applied.

B) If PO timing is slower, we can still enable the uplift on a provisional basis; we would record the consumption and wait for PO to attach the proforma prior to final billing. In that case, please confirm the PO number within 10 business days.

Required PO fields for clean processing: 
- PineTree company legal name
- PO number (exact string)
- Line description: "Redwood temporary capacity uplift — DEAL-PT-00459 (surge window)"
- Currency (USD) and billing contact email

We will issue the proforma once you confirm the uplift ceiling (either 2x baseline or a dollar ceiling). If you want the credit ($12k) to apply, please sign the short-form amendment and return it to contracts@redwood.com — we can make the credit conditional on that signature.

I’ll attach the proforma and include a sample PO stub so procurement can copy/paste.

— Ben Carter
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: surge_invoice_proforma.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Oliver Stevens <oliver.stevens@pinetree.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pinetree.ai, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MV2 surge — provisional capacity top-up & invoice reconciliation

Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses.

We accept Redwood’s provisional uplift for the next 72 hours and will provide a PO. PO details below: 
- PO#: PT-789
- Company legal name: PineTree Retail, Inc.
- Line description: Redwood temporary capacity uplift — DEAL-PT-00459 (surge window)
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@pinetree.ai

We will sign the short-form amendment to make the $12k credit effective. Please confirm when the uplift is live and the ceiling is set to 2x baseline. We’d also like the proforma for our records (attach to PO).
